name: Tommy Skinner
role: Medora cowhand; member of the Marquise's 1885 hunting party
bio: Tommy Skinner went with the Marquise de Mores' hunting party to the Big Horn country in July 1885 and brought the stock back to Medora. In February 1886 he went to the Cave Hills with Lloyd Roberts and fell sick at a camp on the return.
